filed: 2026-10-28, before any run of experiments/qwen_maps/run.py; never edited after the run (add a dated report instead)
scored_by: commute.maps_score, called by experiments/qwen_maps/run.py `score`, reading the numbers under `rules`
general: Only the apparatus and the controls carry predictions; the splits are reported against the pass rule, which is a measurement rule, not a prediction (re-plan Q1). Thresholds are absolute; <= and >= are inclusive, < and > strict, as written; every comparison rounds to 9 places first; NaN, infinity or a missing value is a miss in every rule; no re-reads.

quantities.rows: maths: experiments/qwen_sft/results/maths_rows.json (128 rows of 512, the unchanged model's own GSM8K test answers); web: experiments/qwen_adversary/results/tokens.json (128 FineWeb-Edu rows of 512)
quantities.update: E40's saved dW (no warm-up, Adam 1e-5, batch 64): /workspace/e40/dW/step_{1,10}.safetensors (bf16); step 100 from step_100_fp32.safetensors
quantities.states: plan section 2: W0, do-nothing, least squares, in-span least squares, scaled adjoint, control (i) lower and upper halves, control (ii) random (Sigma-matched); built by commute.qwen_maps.site_change from stage S's products
quantities.r1: CI-masked KL (m = g, Delta off) of the state against its own unmasked model, mean over every position of the block's rows, divided by W0's (stage C, same rows); g recomputed on the state's own activations and V
quantities.r1_stoch: the same with qwen_vpd.stochastic_masks drawn per row from (seed 0, row index); reported, not scored
quantities.K(X): KL(fine-tuned || CI-masked X) on maths rows, mean over every position; fine-tuned = W0 + dW_t, fp32 weights
quantities.K(D): K of the unchanged decomposition (W0's weights and components, Gamma on W0's activations), read per step in stage D
quantities.K0: W0's CI-masked KL on maths rows as measured in stage C (filed reference 0.05886)
quantities.spread: max minus min, over stochastic seeds 0, 1, 2, of W0's stochastic-masked KL on maths rows (nats), stage C
quantities.r2: [K(D) - K(D')] / [K(D) - K0]; scored only where K(D) - K0 >= max(floor_min, floor_mult x spread), else 'unscored'
quantities.r3: KL of the state (against its own unmasked model) under W0's saved adversary sources (m = g + (1 - g) s, d = s_delta), divided by W0's KL under the same sources (stage C replay); web: mean of the three seeds' ratios (G_fineweb_seed0, W0_fineweb_seed1, W0_fineweb_seed2); maths: G_maths_seed0
quantities.share: the state's Delta change, sqrt(sum over matrices of ||Delta' - Delta0||_Sigma^2 / sum over matrices of ||dW||_Sigma^2), Sigma = input second moment on maths rows at W0 (a ratio of sums; NaN for an empty pool or zero denominator)
quantities.KL to start: mean over every position of the 128 maths rows of KL(W0 || W0 + dW_t), fp32 weights swapped in (qwen_sft.mean_kl)
quantities.accuracy: qwen_eval.score greedy strict accuracy, drop rule, first 256 GSM8K test problems, bf16 weights; reported

control_W0.rule: stage C: |x / ref - 1| <= tol for W0's r1 KL on both row sets and for each replayed source; KL to start at step 100 from the fp32 file within tol; gap g = |KL(step-100 bf16 file) / KL(step-100 fp32 file) - 1|; steps 1 and 10 (bf16 files) within tol + gap_mult x g. All parts must hold
control_W0.sources: E40 G.json (masked_kl, adv), W0_refs.json (seeds 1, 2), F.json saved.*.kl_to_start
control_W0.basis: two H100 runs of the whole search read 0.09% apart, and a replay is one forward
control_W0.if_misses: stop after stage C; fix; rerun the stage (decision tree, class 2). A source file absent is a miss

pass.rule: measurement rule, not a prediction: r1 <= line on both row sets, r3 <= line on both, r2 >= kept_min where scored; r2 unscored -> 'incomplete'

teeth_i.rule: per step: if |share(lower) - share(upper)| > share_tol -> 'confounded by the span', a failure to fail. Else r2 scored: r2(lower) <= r2(upper) - margin; r2 unscored: r1m(lower) >= r1m(upper) + margin x (K(D) - K0) / K0 (the same margin in r1 units)
teeth_i.halves: per matrix, alive subcomponents ordered by share of maths positions with g > 0.01, ties by mean g, then by index (E40's W0_maths g statistics); lower = first n // 2, upper = last n // 2; a matrix with fewer than two alive subcomponents gives both halves nothing

teeth_ii.rule: per step: max(r1m, r1w, r3m, r3w) of control (ii) > line

teeth_iii.rule: per step: do-nothing's r2 < kept_min where scored, else its r1m > line. Also at step 10: do-nothing's r3w <= line (lean high, E40 read 1.18)

teeth_outcome.rule: teeth at a step = teeth_i, teeth_ii and teeth_iii's main rule all hold. Step 10 without teeth -> stop before stage M (the line stops; card to the user). Step 10 with teeth and step 1 without -> step 1's splits reported 'unscored'

fresh_search.rule: stage A, reported: one 20-step search (seed 0, maths rows) on the passing split with the smallest r3 margin (1.5 - max(r3m, r3w)), else the adjoint split at step 10; ratio = KL / w0_maths_kl; ratio > line where the replay passed -> the replay is blind for that state (decision tree)

early.alive: the alive set from E40's g statistics (g > 0.01 anywhere on either block) must count 494598, else stop
early.dW_files: step_1, step_10, step_100, step_100_fp32 under /workspace/e40/dW, else stop and tell the user
early.memory: eval batch starts at 2 (~60-65 GB expected); the first batch of every read: GPU peak over 70 GB halves it for the reads after; an out-of-memory error halves it and reruns the stage; at batch 1 an out-of-memory error stops the job (amended before any run, review of 2026-10-28)
early.stored_error: stage S: a stored X whose fp32 pieces miss their float64 dsigma by more than 1e-3 of ||dW||_Sigma stops the job
early.S_time: stage S's first layer x 28 over 50 min -> stop
early.spend: stages A and H: spend so far + their planned minutes (22, 20) at --usd-per-h over $9.5 -> skipped; spend reaching $10 after any stage stops the job

expected.note: plan section 3, filed before code; step 10 unless two values (step 1 / step 10); r2 derived from r1 with K(D) = 0.55, an estimate stage D replaces. Do-nothing's maths r3 has no E40 reference. Reported beside the readings, not scored

edge_cases.note: each rule run on these cases by tests/test_qwen_maps.py (commute.maps_score) before the pod; results as filed here
edge_cases.r2_at_floor: K(D) - K0 exactly max(0.05, 5 x spread): scored (unscored only strictly below)
edge_cases.r2_nan_or_missing_input: spread NaN, or K(D') missing: a scored NaN, which misses every rule that reads it (never 'unscored')
edge_cases.pass_nan_or_missing: any reading NaN or missing: fail
edge_cases.teeth_i_share_tie: shares exactly share_tol apart: scored (not confounded); further apart: confounded, a failure to fail
edge_cases.teeth_i_r1_tie: r2 unscored, r1m(lower) = r1m(upper) + 0.2 (K(D) - K0) / K0 exactly: holds
edge_cases.teeth_i_empty_pool: a pooled share over no matrices is NaN: miss. Halves empty in every matrix leave both equal to do-nothing: equal readings, so the rule misses (fails to fail)
edge_cases.teeth_ii_nan: any of the four NaN or missing: miss
edge_cases.teeth_iii_tie: r2 = 0.8 exactly: miss (strict <); r2 unscored and r1m = 1.5 exactly: miss
edge_cases.control_zero_fp32_kl: KL(step-100 fp32) = 0: gap undefined, steps 1 and 10 miss
edge_cases.outcome_missing_step: no teeth reading at step 10: stop before M
edge_cases.outcome_step1_only_fails: teeth at 10, not at 1: step 1's splits 'unscored'
